title: MXI-MemICL: Towards In-Context Robot Manipulation through Self-Retrieved Interaction Memory
abstract: arXiv:2611.32564v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In-context learning (ICL) offers robots a way to acquire new skills from a single demonstration without parameter updates. However, existing robotic ICL methods either rely on large-scale pretraining constrained by scarce, costly robot interaction data or require additional annotations yet struggle to generalize across tasks. To bridge this gap, we propose MXI-MemICL, a framework for memory-guided ICL in vision-language-action (VLA) models. By treating demonstrations as retrievable memory, MXI-MemICL enables in-context manipulation without additional large-scale pretraining or specialized annotations. Specifically, a visual-action causal encoder turns actions and their observed effects in demonstrations and completed interactions into reusable memory to guide execution. translated_title: MXI-MemICL：通过自检索交互记忆迈向上下文机器人操作
translated_abstract: 上下文学习（ICL）为机器人提供了一种从单个演示中习得新技能而无需更新参数的途径。然而，现有的机器人ICL方法要么依赖于大规模预训练，而这种方式受制于稀缺且成本高昂的机器人交互数据；要么需要额外的标注，却难以跨任务泛化。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了MXI-MemICL，一个面向视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的记忆引导ICL框架。通过将演示视为可检索的记忆，MXI-MemICL无需额外的大规模预训练或专门的标注即可实现上下文操作。具体而言，一个视觉-动作因果编码器将演示以及已完成的交互中的动作及其观测效果转化为可复用的记忆，用以指导执行。为了检索适合即将执行任务的经验，一个意图预测器预测下一阶段的意图，并利用它来查询记忆。检索到的经验……
tldr: MXI-MemICL通过将演示和历史交互转化为可自检索的交互记忆，并借助意图预测器检索相关经验，使视觉-语言-动作模型无需大规模预训练或额外标注即可实现上下文机器人操作。
en_tdlr: MXI-MemICL enables in-context robot manipulation in vision-language-action models by converting demonstrations and past interactions into self-retrievable interaction memory, with an intention predictor retrieving relevant experience—without requiring large-scale pretraining or extra annotations.
